messages.status_hero_tagline: Uptime for services you run yourself.
messages.empty_body: Create a monitor to start collecting uptime.
messages.error_monitor_pause: Could not pause or resume this monitor. Nothing was changed.
messages.error_forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
messages.error_validation: Check the form and try again.
messages.error_conflict: That conflicts with something that already exists.
messages.error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
messages.error_setup_closed: This instance already has an owner.
messages.error_bad_secret: The setup secret does not match.
messages.error_totp_required: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator.
messages.error_locked: This account is locked after too many sign-in attempts.
messages.status_empty: No monitors on this page yet.
messages.setup_intro: The first person to finish this wizard becomes the Owner.
messages.setup_mail_body: Connect an SMTP server to send invitations, password resets, and alerts. You can skip this and share invite links yourself.
messages.setup_done_body: Checks run about once a minute. The first result is already on the dashboard.
messages.forgot_sent: If that account exists, a reset link is on its way. An admin can also copy a link for you.
messages.monitor_ssl_warn: Warn when fewer than this many days remain
messages.monitor_ssl_estimate: Remaining days come from CT logs (crt.sh), not a live handshake.
messages.monitor_push_hint: Call this URL on your schedule. If it goes quiet, the monitor is down.
messages.monitor_delete_confirm: Delete this monitor and its history?
messages.monitor_channels_hint: Channels notified when this monitor goes down or recovers.
messages.monitor_channels_invalid: Choose a notification channel that exists.
messages.monitor_schedule: How often the check runs, and how many results confirm a change.
messages.monitor_edit_intro: Saving replaces the check configuration. The scheduler picks up a new target immediately and a new interval on the next cycle.
messages.monitor_create_intro: Choose what to check and how often. The first check runs after you create the monitor.
messages.monitor_saved: Saved. This page shows the configuration the scheduler is using.
messages.monitor_edit_stays_paused: This monitor is paused. Saving keeps it paused.
messages.monitor_leave_body: Your changes to this monitor will be lost.
messages.monitor_name_hint: Shown in the console, notifications, and status pages unless a page sets its own display name.
messages.monitor_type_hint: Kind of check. The target fields below match this type.
messages.monitor_interval_hint: Seconds between checks. The shortest interval is 60 and the longest is 86400.
messages.monitor_timeout_hint: Seconds to wait for a check before giving up. From 1 to 30.
messages.monitor_retries_hint: Failed checks in a row before the monitor is marked down. From 1 to 5.
messages.monitor_recovery_hint: Successful checks in a row before a down monitor is marked up. From 1 to 5.
messages.monitor_url_hint: Full http or https address, exactly as it should be requested. Private and local hosts are rejected.
messages.monitor_method_hint: HTTP method sent on each check.
messages.monitor_headers_hint: Optional request headers. Authorization and cookie values stay hidden until you show them.
messages.monitor_body_hint: Optional request body. Leave blank to send none.
messages.monitor_follow_hint: When on, the check follows redirects and uses the final response. When off, the redirect itself is the result.
messages.monitor_statuses_hint: Comma-separated status codes that count as up, such as 200, 204.
messages.monitor_keyword_hint: Optional text in the response body. Choose whether it must be present or absent.
messages.monitor_host_hint: Public host name or IP address. Private and local hosts are rejected.
messages.monitor_port_hint: TCP port from 1 to 65535. Port 25 is blocked.
messages.monitor_dns_name_hint: Public DNS name to look up.
messages.monitor_dns_expected_hint: Comma-separated answers. The check is up when each value is present.
messages.monitor_resolver_hint: Optional DNS-over-HTTPS resolver URL. Leave blank to use the default resolver.
messages.monitor_warn_hint: The monitor is down while the certificate has fewer days left than this.
messages.monitor_grace_hint: Extra seconds to wait after a missed push before the heartbeat is down.
messages.monitor_name_invalid: Enter a name up to 120 characters.
messages.monitor_interval_invalid: Use a whole number of seconds from 60 to 86400.
messages.monitor_timeout_invalid: Use a whole number of seconds from 1 to 30.
messages.monitor_retries_invalid: Use a whole number from 1 to 5.
messages.monitor_recovery_invalid: Use a whole number from 1 to 5.
messages.monitor_url_invalid: Enter a full http or https URL.
messages.monitor_url_blocked: That URL host cannot be checked.
messages.monitor_host_private: Private and local hosts cannot be checked.
messages.monitor_port_blocked: Port 25 is blocked. Use 587 or 465 for mail.
messages.monitor_dns_name_invalid: Enter the DNS name to look up.
messages.monitor_dns_expected_invalid: Enter at least one expected answer.
messages.monitor_resolver_invalid: Enter a full resolver URL, or leave the field blank.
messages.monitor_warn_invalid: Enter a number of days from 1 to 365.
messages.monitor_grace_invalid: Enter a grace period from 0 to 86400 seconds.
messages.monitor_headers_invalid: Each header needs a name and a value up to 500 characters.
messages.monitor_statuses_invalid: Enter one or more status codes from 100 to 599.
messages.monitor_keyword_invalid: Keyword must be 500 characters or fewer.
messages.monitor_json_invalid: Check the JSON path and expected value.
messages.monitor_body_invalid: Request body must be 8000 characters or fewer.
messages.monitor_generic_invalid: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
messages.chart_empty: No samples in this range yet.
messages.page_root_note: Only one status page can be the home page. Turning this on for this page turns it off for every other page. /s/{slug} keeps working.
messages.page_root_current: This page is the home page.
messages.page_root_unpublished: Publish this page before it can be the home page.
messages.team_transfer_confirm: Make this person the Owner? You will become an Admin.
messages.token_once: Copy this token now. It will not be shown again.
messages.settings_test_hint: This inbox is for this test only. Invitations and alerts use their own recipients.
messages.settings_test_unsaved: Send test uses the values in this form. They are not saved. Invites and alerts keep using the saved settings until you save, and this result is not recorded as the last test.
messages.settings_test_saved: Send test uses the saved email settings.
messages.settings_test_secrets: Send test uses the Worker SMTP secrets. Those secrets override this form and the saved settings.
messages.settings_test_need_fields: Fill in the required fields before sending a test.
messages.settings_test_need_driver: Choose SMTP or Cloudflare Email Service before sending a test.
messages.settings_test_need_password: Enter the SMTP password. No password is stored yet.
messages.settings_test_need_recipient: Enter a valid address for the test message, or leave it blank to use your account email.
messages.settings_test_ok_form: Test message accepted. These values are not saved yet.
messages.settings_test_ok_secrets: Test message accepted. The message used the Worker SMTP secrets.
messages.settings_last_test_ok: Last test of the saved settings succeeded.
messages.settings_last_test_fail: Last test of the saved settings failed. {reason}
messages.settings_secrets_override: Worker secrets SMTP_HOST and MAIL_FROM are the active source. Saved settings are used only when those secrets are not set.
messages.settings_mail_intro: Choose how this instance sends invitations, password resets, and alert email.
messages.settings_mail_source_secrets: Active source: Worker secrets. SMTP_HOST and MAIL_FROM are set, so those secrets are used for sending. Values saved here are kept and used only when the secrets are removed.
messages.settings_mail_source_database: Active source: SMTP settings saved on this page.
messages.settings_mail_source_cloudflare: Active source: the Cloudflare Email Service send_email binding (EMAIL).
messages.settings_mail_source_cloudflare_unbound: Cloudflare Email Service is selected, but this Worker has no send_email binding. Mail cannot be sent until that binding is added.
messages.settings_mail_source_none: Active source: none. Email is off. You can still copy invitation and reset links.
messages.settings_driver_hint: External SMTP uses the host below. Cloudflare Email Service uses the send_email binding. No email turns delivery off.
messages.settings_host_hint: Public hostname of the SMTP server. Use a DNS-only record. Private addresses, localhost, and Cloudflare-proxied names cannot receive SMTP from Workers.
messages.settings_port_hint: Use 587 with STARTTLS, or 465 with TLS. Port 25 is blocked.
messages.settings_security_hint: STARTTLS upgrades the connection after hello. TLS encrypts from the start. None sends without encryption.
messages.settings_username_hint: Leave blank when the server does not require a sign-in.
messages.settings_password_hint: Stored encrypted with the instance key and never shown again. Leave blank to keep the current password.
messages.settings_from_name_hint: Name recipients see beside the from address.
messages.settings_from_address_hint: Address messages are sent from. The SMTP server must allow it.
messages.settings_instance_hint: Shown in invitation, password-reset, and test emails, and used as the name of this installation.
messages.notify_unstable_body: {name} changed state several times in 30 minutes. Further alerts are paused until it settles.
messages.mail_test_body: This is a test message from {instance}.
messages.mail_stage_config: Email is not ready to send.
messages.mail_stage_connect: Could not connect to the SMTP server.
messages.mail_stage_tls: The SMTP connection could not be encrypted.
messages.mail_stage_auth: The SMTP server rejected the username or password.
messages.mail_stage_send: The SMTP server refused the message.
messages.mail_reason_not_configured: Email is not configured. Choose SMTP or Cloudflare Email Service.
messages.mail_reason_incomplete_smtp: SMTP settings are incomplete. Add the host, port, security, and from name.
messages.mail_reason_port_25: Port 25 is blocked. Use port 587 with STARTTLS or port 465 with TLS.
messages.mail_reason_unsupported_port: Only port 587 (STARTTLS) and port 465 (TLS) are supported.
messages.mail_reason_blocked_host: That SMTP host is private, local, or not reachable on the public internet. Proxied Cloudflare hostnames are blocked too. Use a DNS-only public hostname.
messages.mail_reason_missing_binding: Cloudflare Email Service is not connected. Add the send_email binding after Email Service is enabled.
messages.mail_reason_missing_encryption_key: The stored SMTP password cannot be read because the encryption key is missing. Set the encryption key, or type the password again.
messages.mail_password_unreadable: The stored SMTP password could not be read.
messages.error_setup_unavailable: The setup secret is not configured.
messages.error_reset_invalid: This reset link is no longer valid.
messages.error_invite_invalid: This invite is no longer valid.
messages.error_invite_email: Use the email address this invite was sent to.
messages.error_email_taken: An account with that email already exists.
messages.error_page_publish_root: Publish the page before serving it at the site root.
messages.error_role_transfer: Transfer ownership instead of assigning the owner role.
messages.error_owner_only: Only an owner can change another owner.
messages.error_cannot_own: That member cannot become the owner.
messages.error_scopes: Those scopes are wider than your role.
messages.error_token_revoke: You can only revoke your own tokens.
messages.error_access_later: Cloudflare Access mode is stored for later and is not enforced in this version.
messages.error_passkey_confirm: Confirm with your password or authenticator code.
messages.page_accent_hint: Optional hex color, such as #2563eb. It draws a small bar on the public page. Leave blank to use the theme.
messages.page_accent_invalid: Use a hex color such as #2563eb, or leave the field blank.
messages.page_announcement_hint: Highlighted message under the description. Leave blank to hide it.
messages.page_create_intro: Set the public name, address, message, and monitor layout. Nothing is saved until you create the page.
messages.page_delete_body: The public page and its layout are removed. Monitors are not deleted.
messages.page_description_hint: Short explanation under the title. Leave blank to hide it.
messages.page_display_hint: Optional public label. This editor keeps the monitor name either way. Leave blank to use the monitor name on the public page.
messages.page_edit_intro: Changes stay on this page until you save. The public page updates after a successful save.
messages.page_empty_sections: Empty sections are left out. Add a monitor to keep a section.
messages.page_footer_hint: Text at the bottom of the public page. Leave blank to hide it.
messages.page_layout_empty_body: Add a section, then choose the monitors visitors should see and the order they appear in.
messages.page_layout_hint: Group monitors into sections. Drag a handle to reorder, or focus a handle and press the arrow keys. The actions menu moves a monitor into another section.
messages.page_leave_body: Your changes to this status page will be lost.
messages.page_list_empty: No status pages yet. Create one to publish uptime.
messages.page_logo_hint: Optional image URL shown above the title. Leave blank for no logo.
messages.page_logo_invalid: Enter a full http or https image URL, or leave the field blank.
messages.page_monitor_all_used: Every monitor is already on this page.
messages.page_monitor_hint: The public page shows the monitor name unless you set a display name.
messages.page_monitor_none: Create a monitor before you can add one here.
messages.page_monitor_search: Search by name, type, or target
messages.page_preview_hint: This follows the form. The public page changes only after you save or create.
messages.page_public_after_create: The public page link appears after the page is created.
messages.page_public_slug_dirty: The public link still uses the last saved address until you save.
messages.page_public_unpublished: Publish the page to open the public view.
messages.page_published_hint: A published page is visible to anyone with the link. Unpublished pages stay hidden.
messages.page_reorder_keys: While a drag handle is focused, arrow up and arrow down change its order.
messages.page_root_conflict: Another status page is already the home page. Refresh and try again.
messages.page_root_create_hint: Applied when you create the page. Only one published page can be the home page, and choosing this one clears the others.
messages.page_root_failed: The home page setting was not changed. Try again.
messages.page_root_unpublish_hint: Saving while unpublished removes this page from the home page.
messages.page_section_delete_body: Monitors in this section are removed from the page. The monitors themselves are not deleted.
messages.page_section_empty: Add a monitor to show this section on the public page.
messages.page_section_hint: Public heading above these monitors. Leave blank to hide it.
messages.page_sections_duplicate: Each section that contains a monitor needs its own name. Two blank names count as the same section.
messages.page_slug_conflict: That address is already used. Choose a different slug.
messages.page_slug_hint: Public address: /s/your-slug. Use lowercase letters, numbers, and single hyphens. It cannot start or end with a hyphen.
messages.page_slug_invalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
messages.page_title_hint: Shown as the heading on the public status page.
